title: The Job
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares for Jim's interview in New York, while Michael considers a new job and navigates complex relationships with Jan and others. Dwight announces he will be Jim's new boss, and Michael discusses performance stats with David. Jan expresses emotional distress and considers living with Michael, who ultimately withdraws from a corporate job consideration. The episode features humorous interactions, relationship tensions, and plans for future changes at Dunder Mifflin.
